declarations.name: DecodeFrameRecords
declarations.note: Generic sequential entity loop compared with native on 32 New/Delta/Delete/reuse chains under strict and non-strict generation policy. Sixteen stale-generation chains stop in strict mode and complete relaxed. Native-tail API adds 384 complete/truncated source cases, 304 consuming synthetic tail bits, with ordered records and boundaries compared; every record retains padding provenance. Existing bounded default remains strict. Native reader/world integration remains broader: observer inheritance and reader-owned position accumulation are not claimed equivalent to this explicit-boundary EntityBindings API. Generic wildcard generation state now has 256 native comparison cases across absent/matching/mismatched/wildcard initial bindings and both generation policies. Native World has no held-weapon cache; its removal is explicit in pinned world.go. Do not infer that obligation from the stale frame_records.go comment. Mutable NativeFilmBits adapter compares 512 reader/preamble combinations, including nonzero and beyond-buffer starts and nonpositive preambles; caller position advances to consumed end on success or desync. Negative reader positions are explicitly unsupported. Native accumulator has no public installer/production caller (position_capture.go); component-level optional accumulation is separately ported/tested. Native generic entry points now honor the encoding simulation-completion gate (default false), proven on 64 native simulation cases; all 32 false/true pairs consume different ends. Tests supply the native default position-width context. Arbitrary observer replacement and cross-family callback interleaving remain unverified; mobility actions are stored separately.
declarations.evidence: record_chains_bind_reuse_and_stop_like_reference; frames-levelup-v41.json.zlib; generic component/profile fixtures listed in PORT_STATUS.md

declarations.name: Paquets
